name: Advance Panels & Switchgears P Ltd
india_angle: The company has five manufacturing plants in India, including locations in Delhi, Rai-Sonepat, and Haridwar.
summary: Advance Panels & Switchgears P Ltd is a leading manufacturer of electrical panels and switchgear solutions, primarily serving the power and infrastructure sectors. Their expertise lies in the design and manufacture of medium and low voltage panels, with a significant presence in India.
